title: Zanzibar Orchestra records, Nita Bradley, and discography details
summary: Welburn reads the personnel and labels for McRae's 1946 small-band records, including Pete Clark, Kenny Kersey and the Palmer Brothers.

Out in Chicago?
Yeah. See, I would play the dance music, you know.
These recordings we don't have here but they include -- says here, featuring Pete Clark on alto, yourself and Kenny Kersey on piano.
Yeah.
